title: dalea carnea var. gracilis
intro: Dalea carnea var. gracilis, commonly known as Coral Honeysuckle or Coralbean, is a flowering plant that belongs to the pea family (Fabaceae). This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, colds, and respiratory problems, due to its expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of Dalea carnea var. gracilis include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions. The plant's therapeutic actions include antimicrobial, antioxidant, and anti-inflammatory effects, making it a potential natural remedy for various health conditions.
